condition: On Node 24.0.0 / Node 25+, loading jsonwebtoken with a lockfile pinned to jwa<=1.4.1 crashes with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prototype')" because buffer-equal-constant-time uses the removed SlowBuffer.
workaround: Run `npm upgrade jwa` to pick up jwa@1.4.2 (or 2.0.1), which no longer uses SlowBuffer.
